spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dead, expired, extinct, defunct.
2 Calcined, reduced, (metals.)
n. (-तं)
1 Solicited alms.
2 Death.
E.
मृ to die, aff. क्त.

n. (-कं)
A dead body, a corpse.
E.
मृत dead, कन् added.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Insensible, fainted.
E.
मृत dead, and कल्प aff. of comparison.

m. (-कः)
A jackal.
E.
मृत dead, and कान्तक fond of.

m. (-ण्डः)
The sun.

m. (-ण्डः)
The sun.
E.
मृत dead, and अण्ड egg.

m. (-पाः)
A man of the lowest caste, who for a subsistence collects dead men's clothes; conveys dead bodies to the river side to be burnt; executes criminals, &c.
E.
मृत, and पा who cherishes.

m. (-त्तः)
A jackal.
E.
मृत a corpse, and मत्त fond of, mad for; also with कन् added मृतमत्तक.

f. (-त्सा)
A woman or female animal, whose offspring never live long.
E.
मृत, and वत्स young.

f. (-ङ्का)
The fear entertained of a person's being dead.
E.
मृत, and शङ्का fear.

f. (-नी)
A Mantra for reviving the dead.
E.
मृत, सञ्जीवनी reviving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bathed after mourning.
2 Dying immediately after ablution.
E.
मृत dead, and स्नात bathed.

n. (-नं)
Funeral ablution, bathing after mourning.
E.
मृत dead, and स्नान bathing.

m. (-क्ता)
The name of a royal saint.
E.
मृत death, स्व his own, and मोक्तृ liberator.

n. (-दं)
Blue vitriol.
E.
मृत् earth, मद to please, आङ् prefix, and अच् aff.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant sort of earth.
E.
मृत earth, अल to adorn, causal form, aff. अण्, and कन् added; also मृत्तालक.

n. (-कं)
and with a single consonant, मृतालक.

f. (-तिः)
Death, dying.
E.
मृ to die, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-वः)
The ocean.
E.
मृत dead, destroyed, and उद्भव produced.

m. (-रः)
A potter.
E.
मृत् earth, and कर who works.

n. (-श्यं)
An earthen vessel, a mug, a pitcher.
E.
मृत् earth, and कांश्य a goblet.

f. (-रा)
An earth worm.
E.
मृत् earth, and किर a hog, fem. form.

f. (-नी)
A plant, commonly Carmaghās.

n. (-लं)
A sort of fragrant earth; also called Surat earth.
E.
मृत् earth, ताल site, place of abiding; also with कन् added.

f. (-का)
1 Earth, clay, soil.
2 A fragrant earth.
E.
मृत् earth, and तिकन् pleonastic addition, fem. aff. टाप्.

f. (-ली)
A sort of Costus.
E.
मृत् earth, and फल a fruit, fem. aff. ङीष्.

mfn. subst. (-त्युः-त्युः-त्यु)
Death, dying.
m. (-त्युः)
YAMA the judge of the dead.
E.
मृ to die, Uṇādi aff. त्युक्.

m. (-यः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
मृत्यु death, and जय conqueror.

m. (-कः)
Quicksilver.
E.
मृत्यु death, and नाशक destroyer, remover.

m. (-ष्पः)
Sugar cane.
E.
मृत्यु death, and पुष्प flower; dying after flowering.

n. (-लं)
A sort of fruit considered as poisonous.
f. (-ला or -ली)
The plantain.
E.
मृत्यु death, and फल fruit.

m. (-कः)
A drum beat on funeral occasions.
E.
मृत्यु death, भङ्गुर crooked, aff. कन्.

m. (-त्यः)
Sickness, malady, disease.
E.
मृत्यु death, भृत्य servant.

IVA.
2

A raven or a kind of crow, the carrion crow.
3 A tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
मृत्यु death or decay, and वञ्चन deceiving.

m. (-जः)
The bambu.
E.
मृत्यु death, and वीज seed.

f. (-तिः)
A crab.
E.
मृत्यु death, and सूति bearing.

f. (-त्सा)
1 Good or rich soil.
2 A fragrant earth.
E.
मृत् earth, स aff. of superior quality.

f. (-त्स्ना)
1 Good soil.
2 A fragrant sort of earth.
E.
मृत् earth, स्न aff. of excellence.

n. (-कं)
A pitcher, an earthen vessel for carrying water.
E.
मृत्स्ना earth, and भाण्डक vessel.
